sourceFile: 36. MSU-20S15-07 RESULT CHECK GAUSS MG DATE 29.11.2025 (ME+PQC)_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft conflates MG-C vendor comparison, voltage trials, dimensions, machines, and dates into one ambiguous change case.
issues: Primary changed factor is not defined; baseline and test conditions are mixed.
Unrelated sheets and outcomes are grouped under one changed factor without source support.
Machine, date, line, lot, supplier, and voltage keys are not preserved consistently.
Several outcomes use header or candidate text rather than validated comparable metrics.
Some cited rows are missing from visible context or are insufficient alone.
requiredUserQuestions: Should the final case focus on MG-C vendor comparison Beljing vs Ruijin only?
Should voltage-reduction and dimension-check sheets be split into separate cases?
correctionPlan: Rebuild changed factor from source context, likely MG-C vendor Beljing vs Ruijin with Normal as reference only where cited.
Separate or exclude voltage, yoke-standard, and dimension sheets unless tied to the same validation purpose.
Preserve subgroup keys: date, model, machine side, line, supplier, lot, voltage, and drying stage.
Use total rows and final result rows for function/NG outcomes, with row-level citations.
Remove unsupported candidate metrics and header-only measurements.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Main vendor/function rows are citeable, but current citations are overbroad and not sufficient for final evidence.
